proposed_widenings.name: modify_sense_range
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has conditional sense math: it grants Darkvision if absent, but otherwise increases an existing Darkvision range by 60 feet. That is not representable as grant_sense alone without losing the additive rider.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

notes: Top-level fit exists as a passive magic item with no attunement requirement. I did not author content JSON/Dhall because the current surface can only grant a sense at a fixed range, not modify an existing sense's range conditionally.
